name: AWS — S3 Bucket Made Publicly Accessible
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = amazon_aws_raw
| filter xdm.event.type in ("PutBucketAcl","PutBucketPolicy","PutObjectAcl","PutPublicAccessBlock")
| filter xdm.event.description contains "AllUsers" or xdm.event.description contains "public-read" or xdm.event.description contains "public-read-write" or xdm.event.description contains "AuthenticatedUsers" or xdm.event.description contains "PublicReadGetObject"
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count() as events,
       values(xdm.source.user.username) as users,
       values(xdm.event.type) as operations,
       values(xdm.event.description) as events_seen
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, users, events_seen
description: PutBucketAcl, PutBucketPolicy, PutObjectAcl, or PutPublicAccessBlock event where requestParameters reference AllUsers, AuthenticatedUsers, public-read, or public-read-write.
alert_name: AWS — S3 Bucket Made Publicly Accessible

TA0009 - Collection: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
